documentation_location: ECOSTRESS product summary lines 3-14; Collection 2 L2T product specification table; L2 user guide pages 6-15
fatal_gaps: No neighborhood air temperature, indoor exposure, or human heat-stress variable
Irregular clear-sky acquisitions do not guarantee observations at comparable time-since-event
A satellite overpass is an instantaneous spatial field, not a directly observed recovery trajectory
protocol: ISS-borne thermal-infrared retrieval of bottom-of-atmosphere land-surface temperature; L2T is resampled to a 70 m UTM tile, with cloud and quality layers and scene acquisition time.
quality_controls: Collection 1 guide reports approximately 1-1.5 K retrieval error depending on band configuration
required_measurements: Repeated neighborhood state at known time since independently defined heat event
uncertainties: No city/event granule inventory was downloaded, so realized clear-sky sampling density remains unverified.
Collection 2 documentation supersedes some Collection 1 implementation details.

dataset: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature
documentation_location: official Surface Temperature page: product generation, scaling factor, availability, constraints and caveats; Quality Assessment page: QA_PIXEL and ST_QA
fatal_gaps: Fixed sun-synchronous acquisition time cannot supply a diurnal recovery curve
Thermal-band native information is coarser than the delivered 30 m grid
ASTER GED emissivity gaps create spatially static missing surface-temperature pixels
protocol: Scene-based Level-2 land-surface temperature derived from thermal infrared observations, atmospheric profiles, and ASTER emissivity; Landsat 8/9 provides daytime context at a fixed local overpass regime.
quality_controls: QA_PIXEL cloud, cirrus, shadow, snow, and water bits
required_measurements: No use as an air-temperature proxy
uncertainties: The audit did not inventory scene availability for a particular city/event because Milestone 7 selection is prohibited.

dataset: NASA PCoE Battery Aging ARC FY08Q4 (B0005, B0006, B0007, B0018)
documentation_location: official 209,708,670-byte archive, nested file '1. BatteryAgingARC-FY08Q4.zip', README.txt sections Data Description, Files, and Data Structure
fatal_gaps: No rest or relaxation operation and no voltage time series during inter-operation gaps
Cells use fixed charge/discharge profiles rather than controlled permutations with matched cumulative exposure
Different discharge cutoffs across B0005, B0006, B0007, and B0018 confound direct cell comparisons
The protocol cannot identify causal order effects
protocol: Four 2 Ah cells at room temperature undergo repeated CC-CV charge, constant-current discharge, and intermittent EIS until 30% capacity fade; operations are stored as charge, discharge, or impedance cycles.
quality_controls: Measured battery and charger/load voltage and current
required_measurements: Recorded open-circuit voltage during standardized rest periods
Multiple cells assigned to different load orders with matched cumulative exposures
Repeated diagnostic features at matched state of charge and temperature
uncertainties: Unrecorded time gaps may include rest, but without voltage measurements they cannot yield relaxation curves.
Other NASA battery archives have different protocols and were not treated as interchangeable with this named aging set.

dataset: NEON Vegetation Structure DP1.10098.001 plus Site Management and Event Reporting DP1.10111.001
documentation_location: official product descriptions, design descriptions, date ranges, protocol links, and issue logs for RELEASE-2025 and RELEASE-2024
fatal_gaps: Disturbances are reported opportunistically rather than imposed under a standardized perturbation protocol
Vegetation-structure sampling cadence varies by plot, growth form, and site and can be annual or multi-year
No generic pre-event equilibrium or post-event completion rule is supplied
Published issue logs include site-specific missingness and identifier changes
protocol: Product-specific field measurements of perennial vegetation at qualifying plots, supplemented by management/disturbance reports recorded when staff become aware of events.
quality_controls: Issue logs by site and affected date
required_measurements: Repeated state before and after a known perturbation
uncertainties: A carefully selected NEON site/event/product combination might support an ecological case study, but none was selected or audited to event level.
The portal as a whole cannot be treated as one dataset or protocol.

dataset: GEDI Level 4A Footprint Aboveground Biomass Density V002
documentation_location: official product landing page and user-guide description of footprint-level AGBD estimates, geolocation, prediction standard error, and quality flags
fatal_gaps: Footprints are samples rather than a guaranteed repeated panel at identical locations
No disturbance-onset, forcing, or post-event recovery protocol
Aboveground biomass density alone does not define baseline, hysteresis, or return completion
protocol: GEDI lidar waveforms are converted to footprint-level aboveground biomass density estimates with model prediction uncertainty and quality metadata.
required_measurements: Repeated identical spatial units through a documented perturbation
Consistent estimator and uncertainty across time
uncertainties: GEDI may contribute spatial biomass context, but repeated-footprint recovery suitability was not demonstrated by the product protocol.

documentation_location: official documentation introduction and data categories; project source record documents computed structures and thermodynamic/electronic properties
fatal_gaps: No cyclic loading time series
No unloading or recovery segment
No specimen-level fatigue history
Computed equilibrium properties cannot substitute for experimental hysteresis loops
protocol: High-throughput computed materials structures and properties organized by material identifiers; it is not a fatigue-test archive.
required_measurements: Stress-strain or load-displacement time series under controlled cycles
uncertainties: Specialized contributed datasets outside the core Materials Project could exist, but they were not established as part of this dataset.
